claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game features a survivor-like gameplay style similar to Vampire Survivors, with automated attacks and hordes of enemies.

citations.review_text:
HoloCure surprised me with how much content it offers for a completely free game. The pixel art looks great, the soundtrack is enjoyable, and there are plenty of characters, weapons, and upgrades to unlock. The gameplay is heavily inspired by survivor-like games such as Vampire Survivors, but it adds its own identity through unique character abilities and extra activities like fishing, farming, and the Holohouse mode.

The main reason I gave it a 7/10 instead of a higher score is that the gameplay can become repetitive after a while. Most runs follow a similar pattern, and the progression starts to feel grindy once the novelty wears off. Players who aren't interested in Hololive or VTuber references may also find some of the charm lost on them.

That said, HoloCure is still a very polished and content-rich free game. Even if you're not a Hololive fan, it's worth trying if you enjoy roguelites, bullet-heaven games, or chasing overpowered builds. For a free fan-made project, it's genuinely impressive.

Final Score: 7/10

Recommended: Yes

10/10 - Came for the cute anime girls, stayed for the absolute dopamine addiction.

I downloaded this game because it’s free and I thought it would be a casual, relaxing pixel-art game about VTubers. 

3 hours later, I am flashing flashbangs of colorful projectiles across my entire screen, dodging a literal wall of screaming fans, and sweating profusely while trying to collect golden coins to roll for more idols. 

It is basically Vampire Survivors but with 500% more capitalism, idol music, and pure chaotic energy.

Pros:
- Completely free but has more content and polish than many paid games.
- The weapon combinations (Collabs) make you feel like an unstoppable god.
- Incredible soundtrack that will get stuck in your head for days.

Cons:
- 3 hours in, and my eyes are vibrating from trying to track my character hidden under a sea of damage numbers.
- Turning a cute idol into a walking weapon of mass destruction feels highly illegal.

If you like bullet-heaven games, roguelikes, or anime, this is the best zero-dollar investment you will ever make.
Very similar to games like Vampire Survivors, just with an anime twist. Gameplay is entertaining and the artwork is good for what it is.

**HoloCure - Save the Fans!**는 홀로라이브 팬들을 위한 비공식 팬게임으로, 뱀파이어 서바이버즈 스타일의 자동 공격 로그라이크 액션 게임입니다. 단순하지만 중독성 강한 플레이와 캐릭터별 개성 넘치는 스킬 구성으로 많은 팬들의 사랑을 받고 있습니다.

🎮 게임 플레이

플레이어는 홀로라이브 멤버를 조작해 끊임없이 몰려오는 적들을 처치하며 생존해야 합니다.
공격은 자동으로 이루어지며, 이동과 스킬 선택에 집중하는 방식입니다.
레벨업 시 무기, 패시브 스킬, 특성 등을 선택할 수 있어 매번 다른 빌드를 구성하는 재미가 큽니다.

⭐ 캐릭터 시스템

각 캐릭터는 실제 홀로라이브 멤버의 콘셉트를 반영한 고유 스킬을 가지고 있습니다.

고유 무기와 궁극기

개성 넘치는 패시브 효과

팬들이 알 법한 밈 요소가 가득한 연출

덕분에 단순한 액션 게임을 넘어 팬 서비스 요소가 매우 뛰어납니다.

🎵 그래픽 & 사운드

귀엽고 깔끔한 도트 그래픽

캐릭터별 전용 애니메이션

경쾌한 BGM과 효과음

특히 스킬 이펙트가 화려하면서도 과하지 않아 시인성이 좋습니다.

🔁 반복 플레이성

무작위 업그레이드 시스템

난이도 상승 구조

도전 과제 및 해금 요소

한 판이 짧아 "한 판만 더" 하게 만드는 중독성이 강합니다.

👍 장점

✔ 무료 게임임에도 높은 완성도
✔ 캐릭터별 개성이 뚜렷함
✔ 가볍게 즐기기 좋은 플레이
✔ 팬이라면 감동할 요소 다수

👎 단점

✖ 후반부 콘텐츠 부족
✖ 장시간 플레이 시 반복감
✖ 홀로라이브를 모르면 재미 반감

🏆 총평

**HoloCure - Save the Fans!**는

"무료라고 믿기 힘든 완성도의 팬게임"

홀로라이브 팬이라면 반드시 즐겨야 할 작품이며,
로그라이크 액션을 좋아하는 사람에게도 충분히 추천할 만합니다.

평점: 9 / 10 ⭐

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game features a gacha system using in-game currency earned from playing rather than real money.

citations.review_text:
Gacha but you literally can't throw money at the creator, 10/10.

Tip: try to unlock Marine early because she's amazing for farming money for other characters and upgrades.

GOSH this game has absolutely no right being as incredibly good as it is especially since it is free.

Even if you know absolutely nothing about VTubers or Hololive, you need to play this. It takes the Vampire Survivors horde-survival formula, polishes it to absolute perfection, and packs it with so much content that it puts massive paid games to shame.

The core gameplay loop is dangerously satisfying. You start off weak, swatting away a few enemies, and within twenty minutes, you are a god melting thousands of enemies at once.

The absolute best part of a run is figuring out the "Collabs." Combining max-level weapons into massive, screen-clearing super-attacks is unbelievably satisfying. Trying to find the perfect broken build for your favorite character never gets old.

The music goes incredibly hard. The fast-paced, high-energy tracks perfectly match the sheer chaos happening on your screen and keep your adrenaline pumping the entire run.

There are dozens of characters, and none of them feel like simple reskins. They all have unique skills and special moves that completely change how you approach the game.

Usually, games with character unlocks rely on annoying microtransactions, but HoloCure does not ask for a single penny. You use the coins you earn in-game to pull for new characters. It triggers all the fun parts of a gacha system with literally zero of the real-world guilt or wallet drain.

If you need a break from the endless hordes, there is an entire life-simulator mode baked in where you can fish, farm, decorate your house, and hire workers. It adds a completely different, chill layer to the grind.

Every run gives you coins to permanently upgrade your stats, meaning even if you lose, you are always making progress and coming back stronger.

[h2]Verdict[/h2]
It is an absolute masterpiece of the genre, packed with charm, intense gameplay, and deeply rewarding progression. The fact that the developer made a game this high-quality and just gave it away for…

This is not just another Vampire Survivors clone. There are much more systems at play, more characters, entire housing system. I'm not too deep into VT lore, so most characters I do not recognize, but they definitely have some "theme" going on for each: one is all about food, another is all about shooting, another is about area and size... In other words, you do not need much knowledge about HoloLive or VTubers, you may miss some references if you don't but game would still be coherent.

There is a gacha system, but it runs on ingame currency, so not much different from "random drops" in thousands other games.

One thing I wish is for screen to be less cluttered with effects and sprites to be of higher resolution. I understand that some of it may be a stylistic and/or production cost choice.

If you are into RPG-lite games with 15-20 minute sessions and fan of anime - highly recommend. This game might be outright dangerous to you, given how addictive it is :)

this game is very fun, but we have some minor cons to talk about:

holocure is very enjoyable and so, but it's mainly focused around two things: the main, vampire survivors-inspired gameplay, and the holo house. sure, the holo house has many things such as fishing, cooking, farming, customizing a house, foraging, slavery, and gambling. (and no, i don't want to mention the tower...) but i played the holo house mostly because it was easier to get coins to max out my stats and gamble for characters, but after a while when all of that is finished (except fishing and the tower), it feels boring to continue walking around the house so then i really started the "normal game". and it was a big regret, so don't do the same mistake as me.

this game is also scarily demanding, so don't expect it to run on all computers. sure, i have a pretty old computer but seriously, this is a literal pixel graphics game. it should be able to run on like an NES. my computer specs are quite good since i get around 40 fps in minecraft with maxed out settings and almost 200 fps in geometry dash in certain levels (both in 1080p). and holocure, that i run at literal 360p?! this game needs to be optimized, it never ran this bad from what i can remember. at least it's not a game that needs to run well, but it slows down instead of stuttering when it's lagging, and i've only seen this in another pixel graphics game; terraria.

but overall, my rating is a strong 8/10. you should really try this game!

claims.claim: Runs well on older computer hardware.

citations.review_text:
Runs on my computer, which was already weak in 2016. 
Free of charge (legally!) to play.
One of the few thriving passion projects out there. So the developer cares at least minimally. 
 
Holocure is easily Top 4 for one of the most enjoyable bullet-heaven roguelites out there, with a decent amount of gameplay variety, interesting combat choices, out-of-combat activities (including cooking for buffs). Any character can be unlocked at any time, and as of this review there's over 40 of them, all with different possible tactics and builds.

As of this review's writing, it's still receiving ongoing updates and chiptune soundtrack based on Cover Corps.'s V-Tubing division, Hololive, making use of each streamer's personality and in-jokes to build decently diverse kits and items. Controls are good (and bound to get better by v0.8), balancing is serviceable (making the "bullet-heaven" part of the deal important), and for once we get a colorful, lively roguelite, with a wealth of silly anime girls, if that's your stuff. 
 
Also, there's a [b]fishing[/b] rhythm minigame. [i]And[/i] slots.

Even if you don’t know anything about vtubers in the slightest if you enjoy survivors likes this could easily become your favorite.

You can even use a golden anvil to combine multiple items into a "collab", a stronger version of them.

Apparently the developer will be adding a dungeon crawler side mode, essentially expanding the roguelike which is always welcome in my book.

If you're looking for a free Survivor-esque roguelike made with love from the fans for the fans, you should absolutely play this one.


[i] There's also a fox character so say no more, I'm already sold. [/i]

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the game as entirely free with no microtransactions, hidden costs, or paid monetization.

citations.review_text: This game is an absolute labor of love! So much work was put into it and you can tell with the varying references. This game is very fun and each character in it feels unique with their main weapon and passives helping dictate their playstyle. Plus, it is fun getting to play as my kamioshi! I've put so many hours into this game, and while some achievements are grindy (looking at you, shiny fish, tower of suffering, and go touch grass) it is extremely fun to learn and find your favorites. In the beginning it's tough but as you progress and unlock different characters sub weapons, items, and other mechanics such as stickers and fan cards as well as food buffs in holohouse. Plus, there are fun bosses at the 10:00 and 20:00 marks of every run (my personal favorites are the bosses of the third level in the mansion) Plus, did I mention it's free to play! KayAnimate did so much for fans while not charging a dime for it! Go play this game! It is absolutely a blast!

This is a labor-of-love bullet-heaven roguelite that is completely free to play (no hidden costs). It has a nice variety of gameplay that can keep you occupied for quite a while. Highly recommended!

(it does have some tedious, difficult and/or grindy achievements)

If a game is free, normally you're either ensnaring yourself in exploitative microtransaction processes, or you can keep your expectations low. Sometimes both. But this? This is perhaps the best free game out there. It's a fan game and a passion project, which means there is no monetization and updates are sporadic, but even without a deep appreciation for Hololive, it's an exceptionally fun bullet-heaven roguelike. It's got a simple gameplay loop with avenues for progression in the forms of abilities, gameplay adjustments, and skins. Then there are its minigame aspects, with farming, fishing, and a jump puzzle all being included in a separate area. With a fantastic soundtrack, a bright atmosphere, and dozens, if not hundreds of hours of time you can spend, it's an easy recommendation. I've never noticed any bugs, nor any performance issues, so it's a simple download-and-play.

!As of writing this, the game is completely free with no microtransactions of any kind. Everything below is purely about the game’s mechanics and my personal preferences.!

I usually “finish” bullet heaven games by clearing all achievements (either In-Game or Steam, whatever is less), but Holocure will stay at 60/95% for me. The reason is simple: the game adds a lot of extra minigames and a heavy dose of RNG to its meta‑progression.

Holocure is an 8‑bit, Vampire Survivors–style bullet heaven set in the world of vtubers. I knew nothing about vtubers going in, and you don’t need to either. The core formula is familiar: between runs you unlock upgrades, items, and weapons; during runs you collect and combine weapons to build your character. What sets Holocure apart is its huge roster of roughly 50 characters, each with a unique main weapon and three exclusive skills that completely change how they play. The game offers four stages in normal and hard mode, plus endless and time‑attack options.

As a survivors‑like, it’s very solid. Runs feel smooth, there’s plenty to discover, and the gameplay loop is addictive. Across 100 hours I only had a few crashes, mostly at the start of a run.

My issues begin with the “Holohouse” mode. It includes a fishing rhythm game, a precision platformer, mining and crafting, farming, and a casino with blackjack, slots, roulette, plus a math quiz, pit fighter, and racer. In theory these are optional, but the early‑to‑mid‑game economy pushes you toward them. A normal 20–30 minute run earns around 1,000 Holocoins, while upgrades quickly jump into five‑digit costs. Meanwhile, basic fishing with the starter rod can earn thousands per session, and upgrades multiply that even further. If you look around that there are creative "solutions" for this single player title around - they can alleviate the issue, but aren't the same as progress you have earned. Nevertheless, this imbalance especially at the beginning makes the minigames feel les…

Beautiful game that controls really well and has a ton of variety in its modes for being free. Not as challenging as other games, but is very fun. This is my favorite Hololive indie game, if not one of my favorite games period. The music is amazing; I think eufrik deserves a lot more recognition for these tracks. It controls very well and improves upon the controls of vampire survivors, as well as the visuals. The Holohome mode is great as well with many different minigames, as well as a lot of small things sprinkled throughout to do and see. There are also no microtransactions, not even in the gacha (which I also think the mechanic for is very well made). There is much grinding to be done if you want 100%, and it can feel repetitive and long at times, but overall, it is very fair and manageable. Only thing I think is missing is more characters to choose from, specifically Gens 5 and 6 of HoloJP. As a Hololive fan, I am biased towards this game, but I strongly believe that anyone can enjoy this game, fan or not. Plus, you don't lose anything from changing your mind, so there are no drawbacks to trying this game (plus it doesn't take that much pc strength to run). I strongly recommend it to anyone who even has a hint of interest.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game runs well on lower-end hardware and handheld devices like the Steam Deck, though late-game enemy density can cause performance slowdowns due to engine limitations.

citations.review_text:
[b] The easiest roguelike to get into, even if you're not a Vtuber fan [/b]

HoloCure is so damn fun. It's just such a fun time killer, and it manages to be one of the most fun twin stick shooter type roguelikes since I was deep into Binding of Isaac/Rebirth. The music is also really catchy and gets in your head.

I can also vouch for it being a great Steam Deck game, hell, I kinda bought one (in a decent part) due to this game! I did for other reasons too, but man this game stays in my Steam Deck rotation no matter what because it is the perfect "head empty" game for me after a long, tiring day of life.

The best thing is that it's really easy to understand items/synergies even without knowing Vtubers at all because they are documented well in-game. I really appeciate that as a visual/hands-on learner...

Even Isaac doesn't do that specific thing! You have to wiki dig just to know what your DAMN ITEMS DO.

If you have even a passing interest in roguelikes/twin stick shooters, play it. It's worth the download since it's free, and if you don't like it after a few hours, just uninstall it.

As a fan of Hololive I love all the references and jokes that show up throughout the game, and even besides that the game is genuinely fun and engaging that I keep coming back to play more and more. Excited for the next update whenever that may come! 
The game also runs great on my Poltato PC, and on Steam Deck!

This free game has more contents than many of the paid games out there. The progression has a good pace. Each character feels unique to play. Even if you are tired of the main game mode, there are a lot of side mini games that can earn you currencies, which you can spend them on in-game gacha pulls. Despite being a Hololive fan game, you can still enjoy this game without knowing much about Hololive or Vtubers. 

One thing to note is that although this game may look graphically simple, it can be quite CPU-demanding given the amount of enemies that can spawn in the late game, not to mention the game can only utilize single CPU core at a time due to the game engine's limitation. If you're playing this game on a poltato PC or on a device that wasn't to run Steam games, you may need to tinker with the settings to have a smoother experience. (FYI I could make this game run on my modded Nintendo, but the game can slow down severely depending on the map or the weapon you are using)

This game is probably my favorite game of all time, I've played it for 1,205.6 hours at the time of writing this review and no doubt that time will go up when the next update drops. I've recommended this game to so many of my friends and got 3 of them addicted to it as well, this game was also what got one of them into Vtubers in the first place. You don't need to know what Vtubers are or even what Hololive is to be able to enjoy this game, although knowing about it does help, a lot of the people I've told about this game liked it without knowing what Hololive was at all. It really is an all around great game and you can't beat the price of free. I've 100% every character and the game at this point and cant wait until Kay gives us more!
